title: Local decision connected with close reading
scenario: A learner encounters a real-life situation where close reading and inference pull the decision in different directions. The learner must use evidence and reasoning rather than guesswork.
tasks: Identify the decision to be made.

title: Transfer case: character or speaker perspective
scenario: A new situation resembles an idea from 'A Homage to Our Brave Soldiers' but includes a different condition. Learners must decide whether the chapter concept still applies.
tasks: Decide what transfers and what does not.
